page.notes: Fragment at the start: the page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is cont="true". "MAGNIFICI PROCERES," is set in small capitals in the printed line; it is treated as a level 2 heading inside the running text, but it stands on the line of text, so it may be better read as part of the paragraph. "paternò" and "fere" are joined by the printer as "paternòfere" in the line; I read "paternò fere". "prideè" is doubtful and marked [?] in intent: the scan reads "pridé" with a stroke over the e, which I copied as printed. Spacing and ligatures in "noferè" (line 3) read "nofere" with the e-acute, copied as "fere". Heavy speckle damage in the lower half; "femente" and "frugis" are read with reasonable confidence but the letters around "velut irrigata" are blurred.
